column1: # The characterisation harness's scenario list (the private Windows plan's mac-core §2.3, §2.4; the Windows plan §3 Phase 0).
# One row per commit: every app commit since 38a4cbd (git log 38a4cbd~1..HEAD -- app), and every earlier UI-rule
# commit (git log 38a4cbd^ -- app/Sources, the ones that change what the window shows or when), plus the flows
# and the dialog scenarios §2.3 names. Columns, tab-separated:
#   commit    the commit (or "flow:" / "dialog:" / "perf:" for the rows §2.3 adds)
#   kind      tab-fix (since 38a4cbd) | ui-rule (before) | flow | dialog | perf | not-ui (no window behaviour: why in notes)
#   tag       first | Prepare (the private Windows plan §3: Manage, activation, installs, menus, shared flows = first (the first Windows release); Prepare and Status tabs = Prepare)
#   scenario  tests/harness/scenarios/<name>.sh, or "manual: <item>" for the owner's round, or "-" for not-ui

#   status    scripted (written, not yet recorded) | recorded (A's trace in tests/harness/traces/A, two runs alike) | smoke-tested (perf: one tiny run) | to-script (planned, not written) | manual | n/a
